caseName: Federal Election Commission v. Nra Political Victory Fund
caseNameFull: Federal Election Commission v. NRA Political Victory Fund Et Al.

opinions.text: C. A. D. C. Cir. The Solicitor General is invited to file a brief in this case expressing the views of the United States with respect to the following question: “Whether the Federal Election Commission has statutory authority to represent itself in this case in this Court?” Justice Ginsburg took no part in the consideration or decision of this order.
